contract.task_clause:
Which of the following describes the fallacy of appeal to indignation?
Option A: attacking the character or background of someone making an argument instead of his or her evidence and reasoning
Option B: responding to charges of wrongdoing by saying other people do the same thing
Option C: arguing against a position only based on personal feelings toward the position
Option D: responding to an argument with an expression of derision instead of a counter argument
